title: Topic 5.5: Fruit of the Holy Spirit

pages.lesson:
LESSON: FRUIT OF THE HOLY SPIRIT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.5: Fruit of the Holy Spirit

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Fruit of the Holy Spirit. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should you have the fruit of the Holy Spirit?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: FRUIT OF THE HOLY SPIRIT
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Fruit of the Holy Spirit helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: FRUIT OF THE HOLY SPIRIT
Study Fruit of the Holy Spirit like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives

What this means
In this part you learn to describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Fruit of the Holy Spirit” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Fruit of the Holy Spirit is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Fruit of the Holy Spirit” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Fruit of the Holy Spirit to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Fruit of the Holy Spirit from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Fruit of the Holy Spirit: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Fruit of the Holy Spirit?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you have the fruit of the Holy Spirit?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Fruit of the Holy Spirit means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
